finalText:
**Migrated 12 files off `db.query`.** That was 34 call sites, all rewritten to `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

No `db.query` callers remain under `packages/`. `node --check` passes on every file. There are no tests in the repo to run.

I left `[vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9](vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9)` alone. Its header says do not edit, since upgrades overwrite it. Its 2 calls break when the driver drops `query`. Your call on whether to pin or patch upstream.

I also left `cache.query` alone. That is a different object.
